result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major layout problem where the third restaurant card title is clipped on the right.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row has its restaurant name truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, so the title is cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Constrain card titles with an ellipsis (or wrap) so names remain readable, and ensure the last visible card has enough padding or width so text is not abruptly clipped.
